narrator.n_intro: At the edge of the world stood a lighthouse, and in it lived three children. The eldest had grown very tired of being followed. Just leave me alone, they said, that night. And for once... the little ones listened.
narrator.n_ch1: The little ones had gone after a lantern that floated all by itself. Lanterns do not do that. Not in this world, anyway.
narrator.n_ch2: The river in the Gloaming runs toward whoever needs it most. Tonight, it ran toward Pip.
narrator.n_ch3: Above the Gloaming, the islands drift like thoughts you haven't finished having.
narrator.n_ch4: Every light that has ever been lost ends up somewhere. The Hush keeps them. The Hush keeps everything.
narrator.n_fail: The light flickered. But it was not out. Not yet.
narrator.n_end: They flew home on the back of the morning, three lights in a row. And the eldest never said leave me alone again. Well. Not often. And never meaning it.

eldest.e_ch1: Pip? Bean? This isn't funny! Okay, it's a little bit funny. Come home!
eldest.e_firefly: Come on, little lights. Help me find them.
eldest.e_jump: Jump. Don't look down. Definitely don't look down.
eldest.e_shine: Back off! This lantern's been in the family longer than you have.
eldest.e_low: Stay lit. Please, please stay lit.
eldest.e_ch1end: Footprints. Tiny ones. Wellies on the wrong feet. That's Bean.
eldest.e_ch2: A paper boat. Of course it's a paper boat. Why wouldn't it be.
eldest.e_rescuepip: I've got you. I've got you. You're freezing, you idiot. Come here.
eldest.e_ch3: Hold on tight. If you let go, I'm telling Mum it was your idea.
eldest.e_ch3reply: No. It's not what I wanted. I just didn't know how to say it better.
eldest.e_ch4: It's so dark. Okay. Okay. I'm the big one. I'm the big one.
eldest.e_ch4mid: I'm not scared of you. I'm scared of losing them. That's different.
eldest.e_final2: Lanterns up. All of us. Together. Now!
eldest.e_end: You were. You both were. Let's go home.
eldest.e_fail2: Get up. They're waiting for you.

pip.p_rescued: You came! I told Bean you would. I told her like a hundred times!
pip.p_moth: The big moth took her. She waved at it. She waves at everything.
pip.p_ch3q: You said leave you alone. So we did. That's what you wanted, right?
pip.p_ch4: I'm not scared. You're holding my hand really hard, though.
pip.p_again: Can we do this again tomorrow?

bean.b_found: Hello. The moth is sad. It has all the lights, but it's still dark inside.
bean.b_end: Is it morning yet? I kept my light on. I was very brave.
